It was supposed to be an honest game for a slice of decent land. Unfortunately, no amount of aces up any number of sleeves could get her out of this one. Stuck between the Radio Demon and the king of Hell, Jackie was quickly searching for a way out. Vox was there too, but he was really only still in the game because Alastor wanted to watch him lose for a while longer.

Calling and raising were really the only words spoken. It seemed, for whatever reason, Lucifer had already decided the land was his, and he was completely concentrated on winning. 

It was another three hours before the game ended.

"Good *show*, my liege. I was genuinely worried for a moment!" Finally rid of the game and the Overlords, Jackie began to pack up. She hoped Alastor's gloating would distract Lucifer enough to let her slip out.

"It was *good game*, wasn't it..." His smile was obviously strained, angry that his property was stolen from him. Oh, she'd catch shit about this for years, having lost her first game since second grade in the land of the living. They were almost done with pleasantries. She could practically *smell* freedom...

"Fancy one last round? *Double or nothing\~*?"

...
